paragraphs.text: Jenefer is a weaselfolk from Bloomburrow .

Jenefer is a quick and urgent weaselfolk who played a role in delivering news to the people of Goodhill . She rushed to Oliver , breathless and animated, to urgently relay the alarming news of Helga , a distressed stranger spotted at Pond Creek by Lowenna. Jenefer's swift action and a clear sense of urgency prompted Mabel to abandon her birthday preparations, grab her rapier, and head to the creek. Jenefer’s timely intervention helped catalyze the town's response, setting in motion the efforts to attend to the injured frogfolk and manage the emerging threat.
